CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9108
Date ____

RE:. EDWARD J. HARRISON,

The above man is an American citizen, at the moment
residing in a suite in the Cathay Hotel with a German Baroness,
presumably his wife.

The attached copy is information regarding the above
man. This was published sometime ago in the Manila newspapers,
and Harrison was run out of the place. Apparently he tried
to get into Singapore on his way up to Shanghai, but the
authorities there refused him permission to land.

It is believed on good authority that the U.S. Auth-
orities here have been enquiring into the above man's affairs;
also that someone from the S.M. Police has been making enquiries
about him.

The person giving the attached information wishes to
remain strictly anonymous - as she is a working woman, with
a job in Shanghai. She was given the information that the
United States "Secret Service" are after him for something,
she thinks the attached may be of some assistance to them.

- - - o O o - - -

IW/.

DC (Sp Branch)

事由：爱德华·J·哈里森（EDWARD J. HARRISON）

上述男子为美国公民，目前与一位德国男爵夫人（据推测为其妻子）居住在华懋饭店（Cathay Hotel）的一套客房内。

随附副本为关于该男子的信息。此信息曾于不久前在马尼拉报纸上刊登，哈里森因此被驱逐出境。显然，他在前往上海的途中试图进入新加坡，但当地当局拒绝其登陆。

据可靠消息人士称，驻沪美国当局一直在调查该男子的事务；此外，上海公共租界警务处也有人正在对他进行调查。

提供随附信息的人士希望严格保密身份——因为她是在上海有工作的职业女性。她获悉美国“特勤局”（Secret Service）正因某事追捕他，她认为随附材料可能对他们有所帮助。

CURBSTER CURBED.
_______________

Subpoenaed last week by the Bureau of Securities of
New York, State Attorney General's Office was EDWARD J. HARRISON,
a U.S. Financier, whose calling cards gave his address as
"St. James' Court, Buckingham Gate, S.W.1."

Mr. Harrison was already under Federal indictment for
flagrantly misrepresenting the assets of a certain "Big Wedge
Gold Mining Co."of California.

This time his promotion of the "London Curb Exchange Ltd.,"
had aroused suspicion. Mr. Harrison free under bond, had been
around New York for some time trying to sell stock in this
enterprise.

The royal neighborhood of his address was not inappropriate,
because the chief backer of the "London Curb" was none other than
MARTIN COLES HARMAN, famed one time "KING OF THE ISLAND OF LUNDY".

Beetle-browed King Harman was exiled by the British Gov-
ernment in 1933, after a reign of eight years on his cold granite
Island twelve miles North of the Devon Coast. His exile was
spent in Wormwood Scrubs Prison, where he served time for mis-
appropriating the funds of "Chosen Corp. Ltd.," a holding company
for Korean mining stocks. His only previous brush with the Law
occurred in 1931, when a Devonshire Court fined him £5 for coining
Lundy money in the form of 50,000 "Puffins" and Half-Puffins"
bearing his own likeness and that of Lundy's national bird,
"The Parrot-beaked Sea-Puffin". (Time - Jan. 26th, 1930).

In his day of power, the wealthy King Harman often

场外交易商受挫。
___

上周，纽约州总检察长办公室证券局传唤了美国金融家爱德华·J·哈里森（EDWARD J. HARRISON），其名片上标注的地址为“圣詹姆斯庭院，白金汉门，S.W.1区”。

哈里森先生此前已因严重虚报加利福尼亚州某“大楔形金矿公司”（Big Wedge Gold Mining Co.）的资产而受到联邦起诉。

此次，他对“伦敦场外交易所有限公司”（London Curb Exchange Ltd.）的推广活动引起了怀疑。哈里森先生在保释期间，曾在纽约一带活动了一段时间，试图出售该企业的股票。

其地址所在的皇家街区并非不恰当，因为“伦敦场外交易所”的主要支持者正是著名的前“伦迪岛国王”马丁·科尔斯·哈曼（MARTIN COLES HARMAN）。

浓眉的哈曼国王在德文郡海岸以北十二英里处的寒冷花岗岩岛屿上统治八年后，于1933年被英国政府流放。他的流亡生涯是在沃姆伍德·斯克拉布斯监狱（Wormwood Scrubs Prison）度过的，他因挪用“朝鲜公司有限公司”（Chosen Corp. Ltd.，一家持有韩国矿业股票的控股公司）的资金而服刑。他此前唯一一次与法律发生冲突是在1931年，当时德文郡法院因他铸造印有自己肖像及伦迪岛国鸟“厚嘴海鹦”（The Parrot-beaked Sea-Puffin）形象的50,000枚“海鹦币”（Puffins）和“半海鹦币”（Half-Puffins）而对其处以5英镑罚款。（《时代》杂志 - 1930年1月26日）。

在其掌权时期，富有的哈曼国王经常

proposed a London Curb Exchange to British Financiers, who
saw no earthly reason for it, because the London Stock Exchange,
unlike U.S. Exchanges, deals in all securities, whether for-
mally listed or not.

Mr. Harrison's recent campaign was apparently directed
wholly at U.S. Brokers, handpicked for their innocence.

According to the instrument giving him his commission,
he was to have deposited to his account £200 for each £500
membership sold at 40¾/0/0 fee. He at first announced that
only 50 membership would be allotted to New York, but last
week it came out that he had authority to sell as many as
he could.

向英国金融家提议建立伦敦场外交易所，但后者看不出有任何现实理由这样做，因为与伦敦证券交易所不同，美国交易所交易所有证券，无论是否正式上市。

哈里森先生最近的宣传活动显然完全针对那些精心挑选的、天真无邪的美国经纪人。

根据授予他委任状的文件规定，每以40¾%的费用售出价值500英镑的会员资格，他账户中应存入200英镑。他起初宣布仅向纽约分配50个会员名额，但上周传出消息说，他有权尽可能多地出售。

April 4 39.

The Superintendent of Police,
Detective Branch,
Straits Settlements Police,
SINGAPORE.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No.D.B.19/1581/Encl.(4) dated March 13, 1939, and to
inform you that nothing is known in Shanghai concerning
T.M. GORDON. E.J. HARRISON was employed for a consi-
derable period with the China Finance Corporation, No.9
Avenue Edward VII, but left this city some ten or twelve
years ago. Since leaving Shanghai Harrison is reported
to have visited the U.S.A. and the British Isles, from
whence he returned to San Francisco. From San Francisco
he went to the Philippine Islands and there engaged in
considerable activity of the share pushing variety. About
two years ago he is reported to have left Manila under a
financial cloud and eventually to have taken up residence
in Singapore. For the past two or three years he has been
accompanied by a woman known as the Baroness Von HAGAN
who is believed to be his wife.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sd. K. M. Bourne.
K. M. Bourne
Commissioner of Police.

先生，

谨此回复您1939年3月13日来信，编号D.B.19/1581/Encl.(4)，并告知您，上海方面对T.M.戈登（T.M. GORDON）一无所知。E.J.哈里森曾在爱多亚路9号的中国金融公司（China Finance Corporation）任职相当长一段时间，但于大约十至十二年前离开本市。据报，哈里森离开上海后曾访问美国和英伦三岛，随后返回旧金山。从旧金山他前往菲律宾群岛，并在那里从事了大量的推销股票活动。据报约两年前，他因财务丑闻离开马尼拉，最终定居新加坡。在过去两三年里，他一直由一名被称为冯·哈根男爵夫人（Baroness Von HAGAN）的女子陪同，据信该女子为其妻子。

谨此，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

签署 K. M. Bourne.
K. M. Bourne
警务总监。

The Chief of Police,

Singapore, S.S.

Dear Sir,
I have the honour to bring to your attention
the enclosed information concerning an American citizen
Mr. Edward J. Harrison, also a woman with him by the name

此次，他对伦敦场外交易所有限公司的推广活动引起了怀疑。哈里森先生在保释期间，曾在纽约一带活动了一段时间，试图出售该企业的股票。

其地址所在的皇家街区并非不恰当，因为“伦敦场外交易所”的主要支持者正是著名的前“伦迪岛国王”马丁·科尔斯·哈曼。

浓眉的哈曼国王在德文郡海岸以北十二英里处的寒冷花岗岩岛屿上统治八年后，于1933年被英国政府流放。他的流亡生涯是在沃姆伍德·斯克拉布斯监狱度过的，他因挪用“朝鲜公司有限公司”（一家持有韩国矿业股票的控股公司）的资金而服刑。他此前唯一一次与法律发生冲突是在1931年，当时德文郡法院因他铸造印有自己肖像及“伦迪”国鸟“厚嘴海鹦”形象的50,000枚“海鹦币”和“半海鹦币”而对其处以25英镑罚款 ____ （《时代》杂志 - 1931年1月26日）。

在其掌权时期，富有的哈曼国王经常向英国金融家提议建立“伦敦场外交易所”，但后者看不出有任何现实理由这样做，因为与伦敦证券交易所不同，美国交易所交易所有证券，无论是否正式上市。

CURBSTER CURBED. 


Subpoenaed last week by the Bureau of Securities of 
New York, State Attorney General's Office was EDWARD J. HARRISON, 
a U.S. Financier, whose calling cards gave his address as 


"St. James' Court, Buckingham Gate, S.W.1." 


Mr. Harrison was already under Federal indictment for 
flagrantly misrepresenting the assets of a certain "Big Wedge 
Gold Mining Co."of California. 


This time his promotion of the "London Curb Exchange Ltd.," 
had aroused suspicion. Mr. Harrison free under bond, had been 
around New York for some time trying to sell stock in this 


enterprise. 


The royal neighborhood of his address was not inapprcpriate, 
because the chief backer of the "London Curb" was none other than 


MARTIN COLES HARMAN, famed one time "KING OF THE ISLAND OF LUNDY". 


Beetle-browed King Harman was exiled by the British Gov- 
ernment in 1933, after a reign of eight years on his cold granite 
Island twelve miles North of the Devon Coast. His exile was 
spent in ‘iormwood Scrubs Prison, where he served time for mis- 
appropriating the funds of "Chosen Corp. Ltd.," a holding company 
for Korean mining stocks. His only previous brush with the Law 
occurred in 1931, when a Devonshire Court fined him £5 for coining 
Lundy money in the form of 50,000 "Puffins" and Half-Puffins" 
bearing his own likeness and that of Lundy's national bird, 

"The Parrot-beaked Sea-Puffin". (Time - Jan. 26th, 1936). 


In his day of power, the wealthy King Harman often 


besea 


proposed a London Curb Exchange to British Financiers, who 
saw no earthly reason for it, because the London Stock Exchange, 
unlike U.S. Exchanges, deals in all securities, whether for- 


mally listed or not. 


Mr. Harrison's recent campaign was apparently directed 


wholly at U.S. Brokers, handpicked for their innocence. 


According to the instrument giving him his commission, 
he was to have deposited to his account £200 for each £500 
membership sold at 40$/0/0 fee. He at first announced that 
only 50 membership would be allotted to New York, but last 
week it came out that he had authority to sell as many as 


he could.
